title: Weak elastic energy of rectifiable curves in Riemannian surfaces
summary: We introduce a weak elastic energy for rectifiable curves on compact orientable smooth Riemannian surfaces without boundary. The energy is defined by relaxation starting from a notion of $p$-rotation of inscribed geodesic polygonals, that is obtained by a local construction in normalized isothermal coordinates. For every exponent $p>1$, the resulting relaxed functional detects precisely the intrinsic second-order Sobolev regularity of the arc-length parameterization of the curve.
